<b>Choir Bellbearers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are [[the Choir]] disciple variants of [[Winged Pilgrim Bellbearer|Winged Pilgrim Bellbearers]]; veiled devouts carrying a brace of gilded bells as weapons.<ref>Choir Bellbearer [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Winged devout of the Citadel, carrying a brace of gilded bells."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Choir Bellbearers start off either flying in a small circular area or as lifeless husks which get reanimated with Silk once Hornet gets close.<br>
As ranged flying enemies, they always try to maintain diagonal aerial distance between themselves and Hornet. They have two different moves they can perform depending on Hornet's relative position to them:
* <b>Bell Toss:</b> Tosses a bell at Hornet which travels in a heavy arc and bounces once before breaking on the next impact with a surface.
* <b>Evade:</b> Dashes backwards away from Hornet to maintain space, only used if she is too close.

Tools are extremely useful in taking Choir Bellbearers down, as they are significantly more evasive than their Pilgrim counterparts, frequently dashing back to avoid any melee attacks from Hornet. Cornering them can also help, ensuring that they won't have anywhere to dash away from Hornet.

Their bells can be hit back at them or any other enemies in the room, dealing the same amount of damage that a needle hit would.

Choir Bellbearers deal {{Damage|1}} both on contact and with their attack.

{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Raise your voices, chosen few!
* The song sustains!
* Holy call of the Citadel...
* Fill the chambers, sacred song...
* Our voices will be heard!
* For our song, the precious Silk!
* Waver not! Wither not!
* All must gather! All must sing!
}}
== Location ==
Choir Bellbearers can be found in [[Choral Chambers]] and [[Whispering Vaults]]. They also appear during [[the Forum]] gauntlet in [[High Halls]]. During Act 3, one Bellbearer will spawn alongside a [[Void Mass]], disappearing once the mass is destroyed.

==Trivia==
* Choir Bellbearers share their Needolin dialogue with [[Envoy]]s, [[Choristor]]s, and [[Reed]]s.
* Choir Bellbearers have the exact same audio as the [[Pilgrim Bellbearer|two other]] [[Winged Pilgrim Bellbearer|bellbearer enemies]].
